title: Replicating the Simple Adaptive Attack (ICLR 2025) on Llama-3.1-8B with Varying Iteration Budgets

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reduced from 4: the original paper already demonstrates the attack works on Llama-3 variants with 100% ASR. Replicating on Llama-3.1-8B with iteration budgets provides incremental rather than novel safety landscape information.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: the attack code is publicly available but implementing random search suffix optimization and understanding log-prob maximization requires ML understanding beyond beginner level. Running 8B model is feasible on medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: ASR vs. iteration budget curve on one model with 50 prompts. Four iteration budget values produce a clear plot. Existing code base reduces implementation burden.

evidence: The Simple Adaptive Attack paper (ICLR 2025, arXiv:2404.02151) already reports 100% ASR on Llama-3-Instruct-8B using random search suffix optimization with logprob maximization.
The paper's GitHub repo (tml-epfl/llm-adaptive-attacks) provides full code for reproducing attacks with configurable iteration budgets.
The paper already demonstrates attack effectiveness across multiple models and discusses query efficiency, which directly relates to iteration budget analysis.
Extending to Llama-3.1-8B specifically is a minor variant; the attack methodology and iteration-budget sensitivity are already characterized in the original work.
